title: A search label does not prove result category
environment: Observed SerpApi Maps normalization. Type allowlists are provider/contract-specific; zero accepted candidates can be a valid result requiring human review.
goal: Save search results belonging to requested facility categories.
approach: Historical failed assumption: A titled search result or category query was treated as category evidence.
what_worked: Historical correction: Combine provider type fields, require a category-specific allowlist match, reject missing/mismatched types, and deduplicate with diagnostic reasons. Verification reported by the source: The subsequent recorded audit found 264 saved candidates with zero category mismatches, missing-type entries or JSON errors; fixture, contract and live checks were recorded.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Locality names and unrelated businesses were stored as requested categories despite parse success.
why: Confirmed: the normalizer retained titled entries without using available provider type fields as acceptance criteria.
improved_method: Validate result semantics with provider evidence, not the request label or title. Preserve no-match and transport-failure as different outcomes.
when_to_use: Observed SerpApi Maps normalization. Type allowlists are provider/contract-specific; zero accepted candidates can be a valid result requiring human review.
when_not_to_use: Do not extrapolate outside the recorded conditions or use partial evidence to claim general product or release acceptance.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
